newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia car sales steady in September - Astra.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia car sales steady in September - Astra.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automobile maker PT Astra International said on Monday the country's total car sales were steady in September at 27,884 units, compared to 27,755 units in August.
A total of 33,492 cars were sold in September last year.

Astra said in a monthly statistical report that passenger car sales edged down by 8.76 percent to 2,761 units in September from August, while commercial vehicle sales edged up 0.28 percent to 24,469 units from 24,400 units. In addition, 654 vehicles were exported, it said.
Astra's market share rose to 52.05 percent from 47.67 percent in August and compared with 59.95 percent in September last year, it said.
Astra's commercial vehicle sales rose sharply to 13,055 units in September from 11,968 units in August. But its passenger car sales fell to 852 units from 937 units.
Total automobile sales, including exports, in the first nine months of this year were 237,159 units, against 284,142 units in the same period last year, Astra said.
